title.narrative: UNESCO - Riwaya Museum Phase IV: Interpretive and Content Development

description.narrative:
The project’s objectives are clearly stated at both the overall and specific levels. The overarching aim is to establish an operational, vibrant museum that safeguards and promotes Palestinian cultural diversity and fosters intercultural dialogue. In support of this goal, two specific objectives are outlined: 1. to fully develop, produce, and install the museum’s multimedia exhibition content to international standards, involving R&D activities; and 2. to strengthen the professional and sustainable management of the Riwaya Museum as a pioneering cultural institution in Bethlehem.
These objectives are concrete and relevant, addressing both the software (exhibition content) and the hardware (institutional capacity) needed for a successful museum. The target groups are implicit in these objectives, local and international visitors, the Palestinian public (especially youth and communities in Bethlehem), and the museum’s staff and partners who will sustain it.
The project envisions that delivering two main outputs: 1. a fully operational museum organization (management, staff, systems) and 2. a completed, installed multimedia exhibition
Palestinian public, particularly residents of Bethlehem, youth, women, and students who will engage with the museum as a space for education, identity expression, and dialogue.
